about: The Tata Power Company Limited engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and trading of electricity in India and internationally. It operates through four segments: Thermal & Hydro, Transmission & Distribution, Renewables, and Others. The company generates power from hydroelectric and thermal sources, such as coal, gas, and oil; and provides related ancillary services.
